title: SeaRates Week 44, 2025 Platform Updates
meta_title: SeaRates Week 44 Updates: Tracking, Tools & APIs
meta_description: Explore SeaRates Week 44, 2025 updates with new road tracking tools, expanded carrier coverage, API documentation, and Load Calculator enhancements.
body:
Week 44 brings functional updates across SeaRates tools, expanding tracking coverage, documentation, and schedule integrations. Here is a breakdown of what moved into production and what is in development.

### Road and Container Freight Tracking

LandRates.com now includes a Road Tracking tool that delivers live status updates for road shipments within a few seconds, providing real-time road freight visibility.

For multi-carrier container tracking, we updated our Container Tracking API documentation and refreshed support for 15 shipping lines: Unifeeder, Turkon, Ocean Network Express (ONE), Seaboard Marine, Blue Water Lines (BWL), Avana Logistek, Arkas, Orient Overseas Container Line (OOCL), Transliner, Jin Jiang Shipping (SHJJ), COSCO, Sealead Shipping, CMA CGM, Maersk, and Tarros.

### Air, Courier, and Schedule Integrations

Updates to our air cargo tracking API support expanded integrations for Swiss International Air Lines, LATAM Cargo, Air India, and Lufthansa Cargo. Parcel tracking collaboration was also updated for UPS.

Vessel schedule integrations were improved for Dong Young, Sinokor, Namsung, CMA CGM, APL, and CNC by Points, alongside Namsung and Culines by Vessel.

### Load Calculation and Developer Documentation

The Load Calculator now features an Auto count checkbox. Selecting one or multiple container types triggers automated container space calculation to determine container requirements.

We also expanded logistics platform documentation across several tools. Developers will find updated API documentation for Geocoding and Container Tracking, alongside Help Center updates providing detailed insights on logistics services and SeaRates products.

### Product Announcements

Upcoming platform capabilities currently in development include:

* Unified Tracking System
* Logistics Map Warehouse tab
* Load Calculator Web 3.0 with new design and tools
* Map Platform
* Geocoding API integration with Logistics Explorer
* Inbox integration with Logistics Explorer, Bookings, and Notifications
